source.go_inbound_request_test: conduit/llm/transformer/openai/responses/compact_inbound_test.go::TestCompactInboundTransformer_TransformRequest (subtests 'valid request with all fields' L66-87, 'valid request with input' L21-44)
source.go_outbound_request_test: conduit/llm/transformer/openai/responses/compact_outbound_test.go::TestOutboundTransformer_TransformCompactRequest (subtests 'compact request with all fields' L78-105, 'valid compact request with input' L24-55), TestOutboundTransformer_BuildCompactURL (subtest 'standard URL' L235-241)
source.note: Request-only case for POST /responses/compact. Inbound and outbound Go fixtures are mutually coherent (model gpt-4o, input 'Hello', instructions 'Be concise', prompt_cache_key 'cache_key_1'). The inbound test builds Body via json.Marshal(CompactAPIRequest{Model, Input{Text}, Instructions, PromptCacheKey}); responses.Input.MarshalJSON emits a bare JSON string when Text is set, so the wire body has "input":"Hello". selected_channel, upstream_http and client_http are null because the request-path unit tests do not exercise those stages.

inbound_http._comment: From compact_inbound_test.go 'valid request with all fields'. The Go test sets only Body and Headers on httpclient.Request (no Method/URL are set or asserted).

unified_request._comment: Expected llm.Request from CompactInboundTransformer.TransformRequest. Byte-asserted by the Go subtests: Model=='gpt-4o', RequestType==compact, APIFormat==openai/responses_compact, Compact.Input[0].Role=='user', *Compact.Input[0].Content.Content=='Hello', Compact.Instructions=='Be concise', Compact.PromptCacheKey=='cache_key_1'. messages==[] and stream==false are set unconditionally by compact_inbound.go TransformRequest (L63-74) but are not directly asserted by the unit test.

outbound_http._comment: From compact_outbound_test.go. Asserted: Method==POST, URL contains '/responses/compact' (exact URL 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses/compact' asserted by TestOutboundTransformer_BuildCompactURL with the same base URL), RequestType=='compact', APIFormat=='openai/responses_compact', payload Model=='gpt-4o', len(Input.Items)==1, Items[0].Type=='message', Items[0].Role=='user', Instructions=='Be concise', PromptCacheKey=='cache_key_1'. The content array shape ([{type:'input_text',text:'Hello'}]) is produced by convertUserMessage (outbound_convert.go) and is not separately byte-asserted here. Headers Content-Type+Accept and bearer auth come from transformCompactRequest (compact_outbound.go L41-57); api key 'test-key' is the NewOutboundTransformer constructor arg.
